worldcombat.skill.sparklingaria.summary: Sing a song that blooms a ring of sparkling bubbles around you: foes in the ring are battered by water (hardest at the centre), and every other body in it has its burn washed away and healed a little (the singer is not touched).
worldcombat.skill.sparklingaria.use.0: Hit several foes at once from inside a crowd
worldcombat.skill.sparklingaria.use.1: Wash a burn off a nearby ally
worldcombat.skill.sparklingaria.use.2: Bloom a ring of bubbles while surrounded
worldcombat.skill.sparklingaria.descript: The centre of the wave deals about %1$s damage, keeping %2$s at the rim; the target's Sp. Def, type matchup and criticals settle at impact.
It reaches %1$s blocks around you; a body fully blocked from the song by a wall or terrain is neither washed nor hit.

Every body in the ring other than the singer (allies and enemies alike) has its burn washed off once and, only when the wash succeeds, recovers %1$s of its maximum health; when healing is refused or the body is full it is only cleansed, not healed. The singer's own burn is not washed.
worldcombat.skill.sparklingaria.note.on: High note on: radius about x1.25 and more bubbles, but about x0.85 damage, slower to start and longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.sparklingaria.note.off: High note off (focused aria): radius about x0.85 and about x1.15 damage, a shorter windup and a shorter cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.sparklingaria.timing: Cast on yourself (close to within %1$s blocks); after a %2$s s prepare it spends %4$s PP; it recovers for %3$s s and its cooldown starts on commit for %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.sparklingaria.growth.0: At level %1$s the wave's power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.sparklingaria.growth.1: At level %1$s the wave's power rises to %2$s and its radius to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.sparklingaria.preferen: On: radius about x1.25, more bubbles, about x0.85 damage, +2 ticks to start and +8 cooldown, to wash a larger area. Off (focused aria): radius about x0.85 and about x1.15 damage, -2 ticks to start and -6 cooldown.
The companion starts singing only when a target is this close; lower sings only up close, higher walks into the crowd first.
On: the companion spends a turn walking to a burned ally and singing the burn off; off: only the attack branch uses this song.
worldcombat.skill.sparklingaria.descript: The wave only damages enemies, striking up to %1$s of them at once.
